nodes.name: NOTES.txt
nodes.summary: Helm post-install notes displayed after installing the cert-manager chart, warning about the deprecated installCRDs value and the new private key rotation default, then pointing users to Issuer and ingress-shim documentation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Go template conditionals so the deprecation warning only appears when installCRDs is set.

nodes.name: cainjector-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Renders an optional ConfigMap holding the cainjector configuration file, defaulting apiVersion and kind to cainjector.config.cert-manager.io/v1alpha1 CAInjectorConfiguration.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates the values map in-template using Helm's set function to inject API defaults before serializing with toYaml.

nodes.name: cainjector-deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Defines the cainjector Deployment, wiring replicas, leader election, feature gates, optional config volume, Prometheus metrics port, security context, scheduling constraints, and image pull secrets for the CA injector component.
nodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of named templates (image, labels, cainjector.fullname) with nindent to compose nested YAML blocks conditionally.

nodes.name: cainjector-poddisruptionbudget.yaml
nodes.summary: Optional PodDisruptionBudget for cainjector pods that applies minAvailable or maxUnavailable from values and defaults to minAvailable 1 when neither is configured.

nodes.name: cainjector-psp-clusterrole.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterRole granting the cainjector service account use of its dedicated PodSecurityPolicy when the deprecated podSecurityPolicy feature is enabled.

nodes.name: cainjector-psp-clusterrolebinding.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterRoleBinding that binds the cainjector PodSecurityPolicy ClusterRole to the cainjector service account in the release namespace.

nodes.name: cainjector-psp.yaml
nodes.summary: Legacy policy/v1beta1 PodSecurityPolicy restricting cainjector to unprivileged containers, fixed UID/GID 1000, no host namespaces, and a minimal set of volume types.
nodes.languageNotes: PodSecurityPolicy was removed in Kubernetes 1.25, so this template is gated behind global.podSecurityPolicy.enabled.

nodes.name: cainjector-rbac.yaml
nodes.summary: Full RBAC set for cainjector: cluster-wide read and update access to certificates, secrets, webhook configurations, APIServices and CRDs, plus leader-election Role and RoleBinding in the configured namespace.
nodes.languageNotes: Bundles multiple YAML documents separated by --- inside a single Helm template.

nodes.name: cainjector-service.yaml
nodes.summary: ClusterIP Service exposing the cainjector Prometheus metrics port 9402, rendered only when monitoring is enabled without a PodMonitor.

nodes.name: cainjector-serviceaccount.yaml
nodes.summary: Creates the cainjector ServiceAccount with configurable token automounting, annotations, labels, and global image pull secrets.

nodes.name: controller-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Renders an optional ConfigMap containing the controller configuration, defaulting apiVersion and kind to controller.config.cert-manager.io/v1alpha1 ControllerConfiguration.

nodes.name: crd-acme.cert-manager.io_challenges.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced ACME Challenge resource, including the full OpenAPI v3 schema for solver types such as HTTP-01 and DNS-01.
nodes.languageNotes: A 3k-line generated OpenAPI schema preserved with Helm conditionals and optional helm.sh/resource-policy annotations.

nodes.name: crd-acme.cert-manager.io_orders.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced ACME Order resource, describing certificate identifiers, issuer references, and authorization status.

nodes.name: crd-cert-manager.io_certificaterequests.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced CertificateRequest resource, capturing CSR data, issuer reference, requested duration, and issued certificate status.

nodes.name: crd-cert-manager.io_certificates.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced Certificate resource, defining secretName, DNS names, issuers, keystore options, private key rotation policy, and renewal status.

nodes.name: crd-cert-manager.io_clusterissuers.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the cluster-scoped ClusterIssuer resource, containing the shared IssuerSpec and IssuerStatus schemas for ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi and self-signed issuers.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors the Issuer schema but at cluster scope, making the OpenAPI body one of the largest templates in the chart.

nodes.name: crd-cert-manager.io_issuers.yaml
nodes.summary: CustomResourceDefinition for the namespaced Issuer resource, defining issuer backends (ACME, CA, Vault, Venafi, self-signed) and their status conditions.

nodes.name: deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Defines the main cert-manager controller Deployment, configuring replicas, leader election, feature gates, optional config volume, metrics endpoint, security context, and pod scheduling.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses quoted comparison tricks in Helm conditionals so that a log level or revision limit of 0 is still honored.

nodes.name: extras-objects.yaml
nodes.summary: Generic escape hatch that renders every entry of .Values.extraObjects through Helm's tpl function so users can inject arbitrary additional Kubernetes manifests into the release.
nodes.languageNotes: The tpl call evaluates each extra object as a template with the chart's root context, allowing user-supplied values to be interpolated.

nodes.name: networkpolicy-egress.yaml
nodes.summary: Optional egress NetworkPolicy for the webhook pods, allowing operators to restrict outbound traffic from webhook components via values.
